title: Perseverance
speaker: St. Paul's UCC
description: This past Sunday, Pastor Erica Roth delivered an inspiring sermon on the theme of "Perseverance," drawing from Hebrews 10:19-25. This passage calls us to hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, reminding us of the faithfulness of God. Pastor Erica shared personal reflections and stories that highlighted the importance of perseverance in our spiritual and everyday lives. Recorded on November 17, 2024 at St. Paul's UCC.
body:
Pastor Erica Roth explores perseverance in faith, urging believers to hold firm, support each other, and persist in love, drawing from Hebrews 10:19-25.

Recorded on November 17, 2024 at St. Paul's UCC.
